title: Adverbs of place, time and manner

blocks.text: Adverbs of place, time and manner
в- — the manner of an action, given by the base word
«образа действия, определяемого мотивирующим словом» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of в-. Its examples: вскоре, вкратце, вслепую, вручную, врассыпную, вполне.
Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 4 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).
в- — added to nouns, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'in the direction or location of [the noun]'
added to nouns, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'in the direction or location of [the noun]' — в- + нутро́ (“the inside”) → внутри́ (“inside”); в- + низ (“the bottom”) → вниз (“downwards”)
Wiktionary, «в-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-#Russian).
на- — (added to nouns, forms adverbs with the meaning in the direction of the noun)

(added to nouns, forms adverbs with the meaning in the direction of the noun) — на- + верх (“top”) → наве́рх (“upwards”); на- + зад (“back”) → наза́д (“backwards”); на- + пра́во (“right”) → напра́во (“to the right”)
Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).
на- — (added to nouns or adverbs, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'for' the noun or adverb, or in the state of the noun or adverb)

(added to nouns or adverbs, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'for' the noun or adverb, or in the state of the noun or adverb) — на- + всегда́ (“always”) → навсегда́ (“forever”); на- + до́лго (“a long time”) → надо́лго (“for a long time”); на- + век (“century”) → наве́ки (“forever”)
Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).
с- — place or manner of an action
«места или образа действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of с-. Its examples: сбоку, сверху, свыше, сдуру, слева, справа, спьяну, сослепу.

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «с-», meaning 9 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-).
с- — added to nouns, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning "from the location of [the noun]"
added to nouns, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning "from the location of [the noun]" — с- + верх (“the top”) → све́рху (“from above”)
Wiktionary, «с-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/с-#Russian).
из- — direction of an action
«направления действия» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of из-. Its examples: извне, изнутри.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: from within, from the inside, from inside, out of; on the inside

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 7 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).
из- — When added to adverbs, it can form an adverb with a sense of direction for an action.
When added to adverbs, it can form an adverb with a sense of direction for an action. — из- + внутри́ (“interior, inside”) → изнутри́ (“from within, from inside”)

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: from within, from the inside, from inside, out of; on the inside

blocks.text: Wiktionary, «из-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-#Russian).
от- — direction, distance
«направления, отдаления» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of от-. Its examples: отныне, отроду, отовсюду.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: (colloquial) never, for the whole life (since birth till present)

blocks.text: Russian Wiktionary, «от-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/от-).
до- — fullness, being brought to the utmost degree
«полноты, доведённости до крайней, конечной степени» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of до-. Its examples: добела, догола, досыта, допьяна, допоздна, дотемна, донельзя.
Russian Wiktionary, «до-», meaning 6 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/до-).
